title: Legal Secretary / Assistant - Family & Litigation
company: Harwood Recruitment Solutions Limited - Agency - Permanent
description:
I am recruiting for a well established, leading Law firm in Slough who is looking for a secretary or paralegal with experience to support a friendly and fast paced Family & Litigation department. This role offers training and development, excellent benefits and competitive salary. This is an office based role, the position could be full or part time for the right person.

Responsibilities:
- Assist Solicitors in managing a diverse caseload of family law matters.
- Conduct thorough legal research and prepare relevant documentation for client cases.
- Coordinate and schedule client meetings, court appearances, and other appointments.
- Maintain accurate and organized case files and documents.
- Draft legal correspondence, petitions, and motions.
- Communicate with clients, opposing counsel, and court personnel professionally and effectively.
- Provide support during trial preparation, including organizing exhibits and assisting with courtroom logistics.
- Stay updated on changes in family law regulations and procedures.

Please apply asap, this is a fantastic opportunity to work for a progressive law firm.

title: Residential Conveyancing Paralegal
description:
Residential Property Paralegal

Location: Wokingham, Berkshire

Salary: Competitive + benefits

Type: Full-time, Permanent

A well-established Thames Valley law firm is looking for a Residential Property Paralegal to join its busy Wokingham team.

This is a great opportunity for someone with previous residential property experience as a Legal Assistant or Conveyancing Assistant who is now looking to develop their career further within conveyancing.

The Role

Supporting experienced residential property solicitors across a varied caseload, you will gain hands-on experience throughout the conveyancing process, including:
- Opening and progressing residential property files
- Preparing contract packs and completion documentation
- Drafting Certificates of Title
- Carrying out searches and submitting SDLT returns
- Preparing and submitting Land Registry applications
- Dealing with Land Registry requisitions
- Liaising with clients, agents, lenders and solicitors

About You
- Previous residential property experience as a Legal Assistant or Conveyancing Assistant is essential
- Ideally educated to degree level, preferably with a Law degree
- Good understanding of the residential conveyancing process
- Strong organisation and attention to detail
- Excellent communication and client care skills
- Keen to develop a career within residential property

What's on Offer?
- Competitive salary + benefits
- Supportive and friendly team
- Training and career development
- Wokingham town-centre location

If you have residential property experience and are looking for your next step towards becoming a Conveyancing Paralegal, please email your CV or call Gayle W
